AcpRegistryUrlAuthAction.description:
v1 `AcpRegistryUrlAuthAction` (`acpRegistry.ts`): the sign-in URL an ACP registry agent asked the
person to open, answered by its elicitation id.

`url` is a v1 `SignInUrl` (trimmed, http(s) only, at most 16384 characters), checked by serde
and the schema alike because clients open it. v1's length checks on the other strings are not
carried: the registry driver bounds what it reads, and serde and the schema accept the same values.

CommandError.description:
`command_result.error`, the v1 `AgentSurfaceError` shape.

Reasons the host uses (code / reason): `not_found` / `thread_not_found`, `request_not_found`,
`bot_not_found`; `permission_denied` / `not_allowed`; `conflict` / `steer_refused` (a steer
refused at admission, nothing sent), `idempotency_conflict` (same `clientRequestId`, different
arguments), `notes_changed` (stale notes revision); `failed_precondition` / `not_queued` (the input left the queue, or
`reorder_queued` did not list exactly the queued inputs); `resource_exhausted` / `child_budget`,
`payload_too_large`; `unavailable` / `not_available` (the command's host module has not
landed yet); `invalid_request` / `invalid_request`; `internal` / `internal`.

deduped.description: True when this `clientRequestId` was already applied and the earlier result is returned.

EngineConfig.description: Engine settings for a thread, with v1 `OrchestrationV2AppThread` field names.

EngineDriver.description:
The provider behind an engine, as v1 `ProviderDriverKind` values (goat
`apps/web/src/components/settings/providerDriverMeta.ts`). It names the provider, not the
transport, so moving a provider between driver crates never changes persisted lines. Registry
agents are `acpRegistry` plus the agent id. Cloud kinds are Part 3.

Wire: `"codex"`, `"claudeAgent"`, `"grok"`, ..., `{"acpRegistry": {"agentId": "kimi"}}`.

EngineItemLocator.description: Engine location of an item: `(turnId, itemId)` inside the engine's own record.

EngineRef.description: Last seen engine session pointer (Codex threadId). Not the thread's identity.

EngineTurnRef.description: The engine's own id for an accepted turn (Codex `turn/start` response `turnId`).

Epoch.description: Generation of a `goat.jsonl` file or of the card index. A UUID string.

Fold.description:
Fold state beyond the card: what a reader (or the store after a crash) needs to continue
folding from a checkpoint without reading earlier lines.

Fold rules (lane A store): `input.accepted` queues; `input.delivered` accepted leaves the
queue, declined stays queued and leaves `activeRunInputIds`, unknown moves into the active
run's hold. At `run.finished`, run inputs still queued are delivered if
`activeRunReachedEngine`, held if the outcome is `unknown`, else stay queued; an `unknown`
outcome opens request `resend:<runId>` (kind `resend`) holding them.

Steers: `input.delivered {as: steer, outcome: accepted}` moves the input from
`queuedInputs` to `steeredInputs`. A later `{as: steer, outcome: declined}` for an input in
`steeredInputs` (the engine dropped an accepted steer, `EngineEvent::SteerUpdated` Cancelled)
moves it back to the END of `queuedInputs` with mode `followup`, same inputId, text, source
and attachments (v1 re-dispatches through the normal queue). A declined steer still queued is
unchanged. `steeredInputs` is cleared at the next `run.started`, so a cancel that arrives as
the turn ends still requeues.

activeRunId.description: The run between `run.started` and `run.finished`, if any.

activeRunInputIds.description: Inputs carried by the active run's `run.started`.

activeRunReachedEngine.description:
True once `run.accepted`, an `item.completed` or `request.opened` for the active run, or
`input.delivered {as: turn, outcome: accepted}` for one of its inputs is folded (steer
deliveries do not count). Restart settlement: true -> `interrupted`, false -> `unknown`.

heldInputs.description: Inputs whose delivery is ambiguous, held by a resend request (one hold per run).

lastRunOutcome.description: Outcome of the last finished run, for the `failed` status after later events.

openRequests.description: Requests still open (including `resend`), so the inbox renders without earlier lines.

queuedInputs.description:
Inputs accepted but not yet delivered, in order, with `input.changed` edits applied, so a
client gets the whole queue from a checkpoint.

runningChildIds.description: Children started and not yet reported; `card.children.running` is its length.

steeredInputs.description:
Steers the engine accepted that are not settled yet (see the steer rules above). Omitted
when empty; checkpoints written before this field read as empty.

FoldCounters.description: Running totals kept by the fold. Each at most [crate::limits::MAX_SAFE_WIRE_INTEGER].

FollowUpMode.description: How a message sent while a run is active is handled by default.

oneOf.description: Mix into the current run at the next tool/model boundary (human and worker threads).
Start a new run after the current one, one by one (bot threads).
Merge inputs that arrive within [crate::limits::COLLECT_WINDOW_MS] into the next run.

HeldInputs.description:
Inputs held by a `resend` request. `request.resolved` outcome `resend` returns them to the
front of `queuedInputs`; `dropped` discards them.

InputAccepted.description: `input.accepted`: an input entered the thread's mailbox.

clientRequestId.description:
Idempotency key, kept so the host dedupes across restarts. Host-generated for child and
system inputs.

mode.description: The mode the sender asked for. What reached the engine is in `input.delivered`.

InputChanged.description:
`input.changed`: a person edited an input that is still queued (`edit_queued`,
`cancel_queued`, `reorder_queued`, `promote_to_steer`). Only the changed fields are present.

cancelled.description: `cancel_queued`: the input leaves the queue and is never delivered.

position.description: `reorder_queued`: 0-based index in the queue after the change.

InputDelivered.description: `input.delivered`: the engine answered a steer or a turn start carrying this input.

InputId.description: An input accepted into a thread's mailbox.

InputMode.description: How an input is admitted while a run may be active.

oneOf.description: Only from the explicit "stop and send" button.

InputSource.description: Who put an input in the mailbox.

oneOf.description: A child's result, after the parent's `child.reported` line.

ItemCompleted.description:
`item.completed`: a finished item. User messages and final assistant text are copied;
tool calls keep name, summary and engine locator only.

blob.description:
Set when a body above [crate::limits::BLOB_THRESHOLD_BYTES] moved to `blobs/`; the item
keeps only the start of it.

item.description: The item; its `id` is the itemId.

ItemId.description: A finished item inside a run (TurnItem id).

seq.description: Per-thread sequence, starting at 1, at most [crate::limits::MAX_SAFE_WIRE_INTEGER].

v.description: Line format version, [LOG_FORMAT_VERSION] when written by this build.

MessageId.description: A chat message id carried by user and assistant TurnItems.

ModelSelection.description: v1 `ModelSelection`: provider instance, model and model options.

NativeItemRef.description: v1 `OrchestrationV2ProviderRef`: where the engine keeps this item.

NeedsYou.description: The open human request summarised on the card.

ParentRef.description: Parent link, written on the child (`parent: {threadId, byItemId}`).

byItemId.description: The parent's tool-call item that started this child.

PlanId.description: A plan id carried by plan and todo TurnItems.

ProjectId.description: A project the thread belongs to (card index column).

ProviderAuthInteraction.description: v1 `ProviderAuthInteraction`: what the person must do next in a sign-in flow.

outputOffset.description: v1 non-negative integer, within the safe wire integer range.

ProviderAuthMethod.description: v1 `ProviderAuthMethod`: one way to sign in.

ProviderAuthState.description: v1 `ProviderAuthState` (`provider_auth_*` results). `authorizationUrl` carries an engine `AuthRequired` URL.

authorizationUrl.description: v1 `SignInUrl`: http(s) only; carries an engine `AuthRequired` URL.

ProviderCapabilities.description: All capability groups for one engine driver.

runtimePolicy.description: v1 decodes a missing value as `{enforcement: "client-boundary"}`.

ProviderFailure.description: v1 `OrchestrationV2ProviderFailure`. Producers redact credentials before construction.

resetAt.description: v1 `optional(NullOr(IsoDateTime))`: absent, `null` and a value are distinct.

ProviderOptionSelectionValue.description: v1 `ProviderOptionSelectionValue`: a trimmed string or a boolean.

ProviderProbeResult.description:
What `EngineFactory::probe()` returns: the v1 `ServerProvider` fields a probe can know
(install, version, auth, models). The host adds instance identity and settings.

binaryPath.description: Resolved executable path (GOAT 2; v1 kept it in provider settings).

checkedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of this probe.

installedVersion.description: Version reported by the installed CLI when it differs from `version` (v1).

retryDelayMs.description: v1 `NullOr`: written as `null` when unknown; a missing field reads as `null`.

QueuedInput.description: One queued (or held) input as it stands after `input.changed` edits.

RequestKind.description: What kind of human step a request needs.

oneOf.description: A run settled as `unknown` waits for a person to choose resend or drop.
A choice among options (v1 `goat_decision_request`). Silence never approves.

context.description:
What the person needs to know to decide (v1 `DecisionItem.context`), at most
[crate::limits::REQUEST_CONTEXT_MAX_CHARS] characters.

itemId.description: The approval/question item, when the request came from the engine.

recommended.description: Kind `decision`: the recommended option id. Silence never approves it.

RequestOutcome.description:
How a request ended. Approval outcomes are v1 `ProviderApprovalDecision` literals
(`providerPolicy.ts`); `answered`, `decided`, `resend` and `dropped` are GOAT 2 kinds.

oneOf.description: Approval cancelled, or a question/decision withdrawn.
`decision` request: the person picked `optionId`.
`resend` request: send the unknown run again.
`resend` request: drop the unknown run.

answers.description: Structured answers by question id, for question requests.

ResetReason.description: Why the host discards the client's state and replays from a checkpoint.

oneOf.description: The log or index was rebuilt under a new epoch.
The cursor points past the end or is malformed.
The thread folder no longer exists.

More than [crate::limits::REPLAY_MAX_EVENTS] events or
[crate::limits::REPLAY_MAX_BYTES] behind; the host sends the latest checkpoint instead.

RunAccepted.description:
`run.accepted`: the engine acknowledged the turn. On restart, a run with `run.accepted` or
any item/request settles as `interrupted`; a run with only `run.started` settles as
`unknown` and is never re-sent automatically.

RunId.description: A run: one batch of inputs sent to the engine until the answer ends.

oneOf.description: v1 run status `completed`.
Sent but not known to have reached the engine. Never re-sent automatically.

RunStarted.description: `run.started`: written to disk before anything is sent to the engine (send boundary).

generation.description: Host generation; outputs from older generations are dropped.

endpoint.description: Origin of the custom endpoint the instance sends its requests to.

ServerProviderCli.description: v1 `ServerProviderCli`: whether the probe found the provider's CLI.

ServerProviderEntry.description:

ServerProviderModel.description: v1 `ServerProviderModel`: one model the provider offers.

supportsTextGeneration.description: False when sessions can use the model but application text generation cannot.

SessionCapabilities.description:
v1 `OrchestrationV2SessionCapabilities`. `sourceRestriction`, `executionLocation` and
`followUp` decode with v1's defaults when missing and are always written.

ownsProcess.description: Whether this session controls the lifetime of its native process.

forkHonorsTargetCwd.description: Native fork starts the new provider thread in the target thread's cwd.

ThreadCard.description: One row per thread. Every text field is bounded.

appliedSeq.description: Last `goat.jsonl` seq folded into this card, at most [crate::limits::MAX_SAFE_WIRE_INTEGER].

archivedAt.description:
v1 `archivedAt`: when the thread was archived (`thread.changed {archivedAt}`), else `null`.
Archived cards stay in the index.

cardSeq.description:
Card index global sequence, the `subscribeCards` cursor, at most
[crate::limits::MAX_SAFE_WIRE_INTEGER].

latestAnswerExcerpt.description:
Start of the last answer, at most [CARD_EXCERPT_MAX_CHARS] characters (v1
`latestAnswerExcerpt`).

openAsks.description:
Open requests that need a person (`fold.openRequests` except kind `resend`), folded by the

projectId.description: Card index column for lookups by project.
